name: shinjuku-megadungeon
description: Shinjuku Station as a PS1-style megadungeon, built from MLIT's open indoor map.

scripts.data: python3 tools/build_mlit.py data/raw/mlit-shinjuku-indoor-shapefile.zip public/data/shinjuku.json shinjuku && python3 tools/build_mlit.py data/raw/mlit-tokyo-indoor-shapefile.zip public/data/tokyo.json tokyo && python3 tools/build_astra.py && python3 tools/build_rail.py shinjuku data/osm/rail-shinjuku.osm.gz public/data/shinjuku-astra.json public/data/shinjuku-rail.json && python3 tools/build_rail.py tokyo data/osm/rail-tokyo.osm.gz public/data/tokyo.json public/data/tokyo-rail.json
